skill.name: zhihu-search-api-skill
skill.description: Extract structured Zhihu article results through the BrowserAct workflow API using keywords, date filters, and result limits.
skill.summary: Search Zhihu through BrowserAct and return article titles, authors, dates, links, images, and body content.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown formatting or expected BrowserAct API integration. Confirmed concerns include third-party network transfer, environment secret access, local script execution, API key solicitation, and marketing claims about avoiding access controls.

remediation.issue: API key disclosure in user instructions
remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide the key in chat. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be set locally before running.
Remove claims about avoiding CAPTCHA, IP restrictions, or geo-fencing. Add guidance to follow Zhihu terms and authorization requirements.

remediation.issue: External script execution with user arguments
remediation.suggestion: Document safe invocation with argument arrays. Avoid shell interpolation when passing keyword, date, or limit values.
Disclose that keywords, workflow task data, and result retrieval go through the BrowserAct API.

semantic_findings.title: Secret Solicitation in Usage Instructions

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both cited lines directly instruct secret sharing or offer it as an option. The safer pattern is local environment configuration only.

content.value_statement: Zhihu research can be slow when users need recent articles and full content. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow to return structured article details from keyword searches.
actual_capabilities: Runs a Python script that calls the BrowserAct Zhihu workflow API.
Accepts a search keyword, publication date range, and result limit.
Polls workflow status until completion, failure, cancellation, or timeout.
Returns article title, body content, image URL, author, date, and source link when available.
Reports missing or invalid BrowserAct API key states to the user.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key in the local environment.
Depends on BrowserAct API availability and workflow behavior.
May take several minutes while the workflow runs and polling completes.
Does not verify legal permission or platform terms for each research task.

use_cases.title: Track Industry Topics
use_cases.description: Find recent Zhihu articles about a market, product category, or technology trend.

use_cases.title: Monitor Brand Exposure
use_cases.description: Collect Zhihu mentions and articles about a brand during a selected date window.

use_cases.title: Review Competitor Updates
use_cases.description: Gather structured article details about competitors for periodic research briefs.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Topic Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Zhihu for recent articles about generative AI from the past 7 days. Limit the results to 10 articles.

prompt_templates.title: Brand Monitoring
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Zhihu articles about our brand from the past 30 days. Return titles, authors, dates, links, and a short summary.

prompt_templates.title: Competitor Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Zhihu for competitor product updates from the past 90 days. Group results by competitor and highlight repeated themes.

prompt_templates.title: Trend Briefing
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect Zhihu articles about low-altitude economy from the past year. Build a briefing with themes, notable authors, and source links.

output_examples.input: Search Zhihu for AI agent articles from the past 7 days.
output_examples.output: A ranked article list with titles, authors, publication dates, source links, and available body content.

output_examples.input: Monitor Zhihu mentions of a product launch during the past 30 days.
output_examples.output: A concise monitoring brief with matching articles, repeated topics, and links for manual review.

output_examples.input: Collect competitor articles from the past quarter.
output_examples.output: A research summary grouped by competitor, with article metadata and notable discussion points.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY locally before starting the workflow.
Use narrow keywords and date ranges to reduce irrelevant results.
Review source links before making business or public claims.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or shared logs.
Do not use the skill for scraping that violates site terms or law.
Do not treat returned article text as verified fact without review.

faq.question: What does this skill search?
faq.answer: It searches Zhihu articles through a BrowserAct workflow using a keyword, date range, and result limit.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be set in the local environment before use.

faq.question: What fields can it return?
faq.answer: It can return title, body content, image URL, author, publication date, and original article link.

faq.question: How long can a search take?
faq.answer: The workflow may take several minutes. The script polls status until completion or timeout.

faq.question: Can it summarize results?
faq.answer: The skill returns article content and metadata. The assistant can then summarize the returned content.

faq.question: What should users avoid?
faq.answer: Users should avoid sharing API keys in chat and should confirm that their research complies with applicable rules.
